opening.argument: The invitation is direct: viewers are told to click the link beneath the video and are promised step-by-step help getting started so they can profit from the markets. That invitation is paired with claims of substantial returns, including the assertion that "the profits have still been quite substantial" and that "Everybody has had a very profitable experience with the company." The description further presents passive daily trading profit alongside a direct referral bonus and a weekly binary bonus, connecting earnings to recruitment and a left/right team structure. The opening disclaimer does not remove that active invitation to join and profit or the promotional emphasis on returns.
